name: Whipped Honey Iced Coffee
desc: Iced espresso topped with honey whipped pale and fluffy with a milk frother.

source.title: Whipped Honey Iced Coffee
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 shots espresso (2 oz), or 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee, cooled
ingredients.note: 2 oz, or 1/2 cup strong brewed coffee

steps: Put the honey in a small cup and whip it with a handheld milk frother about 1 minute, until pale and fluffy.
Fill a glass with ice and pour in the coffee.
Spoon the whipped honey on top.
tips: Crystallized or raw honey whips up the thickest.

references.title: Whipped Honey Shaken Espresso Latte
references.usedFor: whipping honey on its own until pale, 2 shots espresso with 1 to 2 tbsp honey

references.title: Whipped Honey Iced Coffee
references.usedFor: 2 tbsp honey to a double shot, frother method
